content.text: Excellent performance (1.25s for a large compressed batch). But I just caught a contract violation while reviewing: *"These flags never infer byte equality from checksums. Routing-identity comparisons compare actual bytes."* — my `_mismatch` compares fingerprints. Fix it to compare real bytes:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - << 'EOF'
src = open('modules/capture_audit.py').read()
old = """    return {
        'start': pos,
        'end': end,
        'method': _fp_bytes(method),
        'target': _fp_bytes(target),"""
new = """    return {
        'start': pos,
        'end': end,
        'method': _fp_bytes(method),
        'target': _fp_bytes(target),
        '_method': method,
        '_target': target,"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)

old = """def _mismatch(record, expect):
    if record['method'] != _fp_bytes(expect['method']):
        return True
    if record['target'] != _fp_bytes(expect['target']):
        return True
    if record['host_count'] != 1:
        return True
    return record['_host_folded'] != expect['host'].lower()"""
new = """def _mismatch(record, expect):
    # Routing-identity comparisons use actual bytes, never checksum equality.
    if record['_method'] != expect['method']:
        return True
    if record['_target'] != expect['target']:
        return True
    if record['host_count'] != 1:
        return True
    return record['_host_folded'] != expect['host'].lower()"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)

old = """            record['flags'] = sorted(flags)
            del record['_host_folded']"""
new = """            record['flags'] = sorted(flags)
            del record['_host_folded']
            del record['_method']
            del record['_target']"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('modules/capture_audit.py','w').write(src)
print('patched')
EOF
